sentences.en: Six additional base lines were measured up to 1849, including the Lough Foyle, in 1827-1828, and that on Salisbury Plain, in 1849.

sentences.en: During his residence in Ireland he founded, in addition to a number of churches, two famous monasteries, one named Daire Calgaich (Derry) on the banks of Lough Foyle, the other Dair-magh (Durrow) in King's county.
sentences.vi: Trong thời gian cư trú tại Ireland, ông đã thành lập, ngoài một số nhà thờ, hai tu viện nổi tiếng, một tên là Daire Calgaich (Derry) trên bờ Lough Foyle, còn lại là Dair-magh (Durrow) ở quận King.

sentences.en: Lough Foyle is divided from Lough Swilly by the diamond-shaped peninsula of Inishowen.
sentences.vi: Lough Foyle bị chia cắt khỏi Lough Swilly bởi bán đảo hình kim cương Inishowen.

sentences.en: Featuring the films of emerging directors alongside the more established auteurs is a distinguishing factor of the Seagate Foyle Film Festival.

sentences.en: We haue been guided by thee hitherto, And of thy Cunning had no diffidence, One sudden Foyle shall neuer breed distrust Bastard.
